curator_breach.speaker: The Curator
lines: Docent unit, you are awake. A breach has opened in the Plague Wing.
Seal the exhibit. Preserve the approved record.

apothecary_intro.speaker: Plague Apothecary
lines: You are not from this town. Good. Then perhaps you can remember what changes.
I died yesterday. The bell rang, the fever took me, and now morning has returned.
